mapper.select: SELECT SUM(ib.on_hand_qty) AS on_hand_qty FROM inventory_balance ib INNER JOIN sku s ON s.sku_id = ib.sku_id AND s.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sales_point sp ON sp.sales_point_id = ib.allocated_sales_point_id AND sp.is_deleted = 0 WHERE s.sku_code = #{skuCode} AND ( (#{salesPointCode} != 'UNASSIGNED' AND sp.sales_point_code = #{salesPointCode}) OR (#{salesPointCode} = 'UNASSIGNED' AND ib.allocated_sales_point_id IS NULL) ) AND ib.is_deleted = 0

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ip.safety_stock_qty FROM inventory_policy ip INNER JOIN sku s ON s.sku_id = ip.sku_id AND s.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sales_point sp ON sp.sales_point_id = ip.allocated_sales_point_id AND sp.is_deleted = 0 WHERE s.sku_code = #{skuCode} AND ( (#{salesPointCode} != 'UNASSIGNED' AND sp.sales_point_code = #{salesPointCode}) OR (#{salesPointCode} = 'UNASSIGNED' AND ip.allocated_sales_point_id IS NULL) ) AND ip.is_deleted = 0 AND (ip.effective_from IS NULL OR ip.effective_from <= #{asOfDate}) AND (ip.effective_to IS NULL OR ip.effective_to >= #{asOfDate}) ORDER BY CASE WHEN sp.sales_point_code = #{salesPointCode} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, ip.effective_from DESC NULLS LAST, ip.inventory_policy_id DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT df.base_date, df.predicted_qty_d7, df.predicted_qty_d30 FROM demand_forecast df INNER JOIN sku s ON s.sku_id = df.sku_id AND s.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN sales_point sp ON sp.sales_point_id = df.sales_point_id AND sp.is_deleted = 0 WHERE s.sku_code = #{skuCode} AND sp.sales_point_code = #{salesPointCode} AND df.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY df.base_date DESC, df.forecast_id DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ra.risk_grade AS db_risk_grade, ra.shortage_yn, ra.stock_days, ra.holding_days, ra.expiry_days_left, ra.rule_version, ra.reason_message, ra.updated_at AS assessed_at FROM risk_assessment ra INNER JOIN inventory_balance ib ON ib.inventory_balance_id = ra.inventory_balance_id AND ib.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN sku s ON s.sku_id = ib.sku_id AND s.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sales_point sp ON sp.sales_point_id = ib.allocated_sales_point_id AND sp.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ra.is_deleted = 0 AND s.sku_code = #{skuCode} AND ( (#{salesPointCode} != 'UNASSIGNED' AND sp.sales_point_code = #{salesPointCode}) OR (#{salesPointCode} = 'UNASSIGNED' AND ib.allocated_sales_point_id IS NULL) ) ORDER BY ra.updated_at DESC, ra.risk_assessment_id DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT TO_CHAR(l.lot_id) AS lotId, l.lot_no AS lotNumber, l.expiry_date AS expiryDate, l.sale_stop_date AS saleStopDate, l.received_date AS receivedDate, SUM(ib.on_hand_qty) AS quantity, l.lot_status AS lotStatus FROM lot l INNER JOIN inventory_balance ib ON ib.lot_id = l.lot_id AND ib.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN sku s ON s.sku_id = ib.sku_id AND s.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sales_point sp ON sp.sales_point_id = ib.allocated_sales_point_id AND sp.is_deleted = 0 WHERE s.sku_code = #{skuCode} AND ( (#{salesPointCode} != 'UNASSIGNED' AND sp.sales_point_code = #{salesPointCode}) OR (#{salesPointCode} = 'UNASSIGNED' AND ib.allocated_sales_point_id IS NULL) ) AND l.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY l.lot_id, l.lot_no, l.expiry_date, l.sale_stop_date, l.received_date, l.lot_status ORDER BY l.expiry_date ASC NULLS LAST
